Messages.Author: skippy
Messages.Body:
so if a Ravnos Acceptance is played

Ravnos Acceptance
[DS]
Cardtype: Political Action
Called by any vampire at +1 stealth. Political Card-Worth 1 Vote.
If this {referendum} is successful, all Ravnos change their status from
{Independent} vampires to Camarilla vampires for the rest of the game. All
options available to Camarilla clans are now open to the Ravnos.

and you control Anka, Priestess of Thorns.
Anka, Priestess of Thorns
[FN]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Ravnos
Capacity: 4
Discipline: ani chi pro
Sabbat: Anka can enter combat with a ready Lasombra controlled by another
Methuselah as a (D) action.

She does not change sect (because she's not Independant) but still has
access the the options available to the Camarilla although she is still
Sabbat.

Now what would these options entail? Can she be chosen to be a Camarilla
Exemplary or Archon, or for example? and at the same time can she be a
Sabbat Priest and Templar as well?

--
Oscar Garza
Prince of College Station
The Crazy Aggie

> access the the options available to the Camarilla although she is still

No. She's all Cam. There is no way to be more than one sect.

Similarly, if you call a Political Flux for 12 and it passes and then you
call another for 11 and it passes, the next Meth to oust someone gets 11
(not 23) pool.
